shadows.name: hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Warm coral glow under lifted cards.

components.name: Sticker Pill
components.description: Small, highly tracked uppercase pill for labels.
components.css: .ds-sticker-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; background-color: #fff1f0; color: #fa5c4f; border: 1px solid #ffc8c5; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(250, 92, 79, 0.08); font-family: sans-serif; }

components.name: GlideCN Card
components.description: Tactile showcase card that lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-glidecn-card { background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 1.5rem; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.2s ease; font-family: sans-serif; color: #09090b; } .ds-glidecn-card:hover { border-color: #fa5c4f; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(250, 92, 79, 0.12); transform: translateY(-2px); }

narrative.overview: GlideCN is focused on storytelling, premium motion, and immersive flow. The design system acts as a stage—clean, unopinionated, and structured—so that the transitions themselves take the spotlight. It uses a high-energy coral accent to draw attention, balanced against a strict, monochrome structural canvas. The result is a highly tactile, responsive, and cinematic experience that feels like a premium interactive studio.
keyCharacteristics: Zero visual clutter; content serves the motion.
Interactions are deeply tactile (pressing, lifting, glowing).
Typography shifts playfully between strict monospace and expressive cursive.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signature Coral is used sparingly. It should never overwhelm the screen; its rarity makes it powerful.

rules.name: The Structural Display Rule
rules.body: Headings are always Space Grotesk with tightly tracked letter spacing to feel modern and structural.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows and glows appear exclusively as a response to state (hover or focus).

dos: Do use Signature Coral to draw the eye to the single most important action on the page.
Do wrap code elements and technical terms in the JetBrains Mono font.
Do ensure all interactive elements feel tactile (lifting on hover, depressing on click).
donts: Don't use drop shadows on resting elements. Keep the baseline flat.
Don't flood large areas with Signature Coral. It is an accent, not a background.
